title: MSU-IRB Review Process chart (image transcription)
content:
[IMAGE TRANSCRIPTION] This document is a verbatim transcription of an IMAGE, not of page text. The image is the MSU-IRB Review Process flowchart (dated 9/2020) (alt text: IRB Review Process Chart). It is published as https://www.morgan.edu/Images/ADMINISTRATION/OFFICES/ora/MSU_IRB-ReviewProcess.jpg and appears on https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/research-compliance/human-subjects-research. The text below was read off the image by machine vision and is reproduced as it appears, including its field labels, section numbering and blank entry fields; anything unreadable is marked [unreadable]. Nothing here is summarized or inferred.
